api.notes: Drawn instead of the mark in either state. Whitespace and comments are not content (INDICATOR-04).

hooks.notes: Follows the nearest tct-theme through themeContext.
CSS module: the indicator-scope class publishes the inherited --_indicator-hover (INDICATOR-02).

hooks.reason: Owner-side: the owning control rings the indicator element with ::part(checkbox-indicator) or ::part(radio-indicator) using the shared focus-ring tokens; an indicator never draws its own ring.

hooks.notes: Per theme name; values are tag names.

differences.text: An indicator "component" is a tag name: defaultIndicators maps check, checkbox and radio to tct-check-indicator, tct-checkbox-indicator and tct-radio-indicator, and defineIndicators(overrides, theme) registers replacement tags per theme name. Owners render through getIndicator() or IndicatorController; dynamic tag rendering without unsafeStatic is the owner's template concern.

stylex.defineMarker() and when.ancestor(':hover') cannot match an ancestor across a shadow boundary, so indicatorScope is a CSS module: the indicator-scope class publishes the inherited private --_indicator-hover (0 or 1), which the indicators read to brighten. Owners add the class only while enabled.

Decorative by contract: the host is aria-hidden through ElementInternals and the painted box carries its own aria-hidden, so an author aria-hidden="false" on the host never exposes the mark (upstream re-asserted aria-hidden after the props spread for the same reason).

`children` is default-slot content. Upstream's isRenderable(children) guard (a `false` from `children={isBusy && <Spinner/>}` must not delete the mark) becomes slot presence: whitespace-only text and comments do not count as content.

Checkbox and radio follow design/components/checkbox.md and radio.md: the box border, checked fill, indeterminate fill and glyph use the Tecton checkbox roles (--tecton-color-checkbox-*), a checked radio is a brighter ring plus a filled dot, and hover brightens toward --tecton-color-checkbox-hover-border. The check mark draws in the icon accent ink. All boundaries and fills are checked at >= 3:1 against the page and card surfaces in both modes (D-013 Q-05).

core.check-indicator.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] aria-hidden as an ElementInternals default; [mwg:styling-web-components] inherited custom properties cross the shadow boundary (hover), ::part for owner focus rings; [mwg:brand-consistent-forms] token-driven control colours; [mwg:css] forced-colors overrides in the a11y layer.

core.checkbox-indicator.notes: See core.check-indicator for the family differences (INDICATOR-01 to INDICATOR-05). Parts: checkbox-indicator (+ legacy checkbox), checkbox-indicator-check, checkbox-indicator-dash.

core.radio-indicator.notes: See core.check-indicator for the family differences (INDICATOR-01 to INDICATOR-05). Parts: radio-indicator (+ legacy radio), radio-indicator-dot (+ legacy radio-dot).
